text:
maya (oncall): seeing apiserver 502s + etcd commit latency spike in eu-west-3. controller-manager crashed once and restarted. multiple GPU pods showing Evicted / Pending. anyone on this? :frowny:

theo: noticed leader moved twice in ~6m. disk await on leader node is through the roof. apiserver logs show watch reconnect storms.

priya: we kicked a large model-onboard job earlier that uploads ~200GB artifacts to our object store. SNAT port exhaustion alerts fired around the same time.

cloud-sre: SNAT ephemeral ports near saturation (eu-west-3) at 09:12. brief NAT throttling window. opened case 11788 and applied temporary SNAT scaling + TCP pacing patch. also gave a short iops burst to the etcd leader volume.

maya (oncall): can someone confirm etcd pod health?

theo: paste from node:
```
# kubectl -n kube-system get pod -l component=etcd -o wide
etcd-ew3-0   1/1 Running   0     50m   10.4.12.5  eu-west-3a
etcd-ew3-1   1/1 Running   0     51m   10.4.13.6  eu-west-3b
etcd-ew3-2   0/1 CrashLoop  6     21m   10.4.14.7  eu-west-3c
```
leader log snippets show WAL fsync wait > 900ms and raft leader transfer attempts.

priya: controller-manager logs show repeated "failed to create watch: i/o timeout" followed by memory pressure OOMKill. watch queue length spikes on metrics.

maya (oncall): mitigation plan suggestions?

priya: short term: (1) pause artifact uploader pipeline, (2) reduce controller concurrency and lower sync periods for heavy controllers, (3) cordon noisy test nodes and spin up a small relaxed-taint GPU pool to drain Pending, (4) request cloud for temporary SNAT/IOPS bump (they already did).

theo: applying controller change now:
```bash
kubectl -n kube-system patch deployment kube-controller-manager --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"kube-controller-manager","args":["--concurrent-deployment-syncs=1","--concurrent-job-syncs=1","--controller-sync-period=60s"]}]}}}}'
```

infra-bot: alert: etcd_commit_latency > 600ms (eu-west-3)  created INC-6294.

cloud-sre: confirmed SNAT bump and IOPS burst active for 30m. monitoring NAT counters.

maya (oncall): spun up spot-gpu-ew3c-relaxed and cordoned 2 noisy dev nodes. scheduling improved; Pending GPU pods dropped ~45% in 10m. apiserver 5xxs down to baseline. etcd WAL wait trending down but still above normal.

priya: follow-ups: (a) add runbook step to pause large artifact uploads when etcd_wal_wait_ms > 200ms, (b) evaluate permanent SNAT capacity increase for eu-west-3, (c) move snapshot uploads to a separate AZ or throttle snapshot frequency during heavy egress, (d) consider exposing follower read endpoints for heavy watch consumers to reduce leader pressure.

maya (oncall): agree. also add a runbook item to temporarily reduce controller concurrency on spike and a gating check for large onboarding jobs so they don't run during peak control-plane load. keeping incident open for another 20m. :thumbsup:
